title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C7.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: M1.7 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 07:46 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 18:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 722 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 5

The Sun just fired off an M-Class flare! Hold onto something! 💥☀️💣🌌

Several active regions and a central sunspot group stand out today, with a broad dark coronal structure also visible.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 131 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
